verdict.rationale: Event-driven automation rules are a fair question for a domain registrar, for example triggering actions on expiry or DNS changes, so the axis applies. The pack shows only an XML API, a Go SDK, a Terraform provider and Dynamic DNS update requests. These are developer building blocks or user-run update clients, not a first-party rules engine that fires actions on events. No documented event-triggered rules or webhooks appear in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
